verdict.rationale: Importing mail history and contacts is a fair question for an email client, but the pack has no evidence that Outlook offers an import or migration path from another provider or client. The Graph docs cover reading, sending and syncing messages within an existing mailbox, not importing from elsewhere. The one community migration note (readpst converting .pst to mbox) describes exporting out of Outlook into another client, the opposite direction, and is a third-party tool.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
